exclusions.source_text: Has Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status (ECOG PS) score of 0 or 1 at Screening.
Creatinine clearance (CrCl) ≥45 mL/min as calculated using the Cockcroft-Gault equation (Section 10.3.1)
Total bilirubin (TBL) ≤1.5 × ULN (≤3 × ULN for participants with a documented history of Gilbert's syndrome)
Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≤3 × upper limit of normal (ULN) in participants with no liver metastasis, or ≤5 × ULN in participants with liver metastasis
exclusions.threshold: ALT/AST ≤3 × ULN (≤5 × ULN with liver metastasis)

exclusions.source_text: Participant is not pregnant as confirmed by highly sensitive pregnancy test (see Section 10.3.5.3).
Participant does not breastfeed during the trial intervention period and for at least 120 days after last dose of trial intervention.
Has known symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or cord compression.
Myocardial infarction within 6 months prior to screening
New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class III or IV congestive heart failure
Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤50% or lower than the institutional lower limit of normal
QT interval corrected with Fridericia's formula (QTcF) interval \>480 ms
